featured_reviews.name: Nirmal Mulewa
featured_reviews.review_text:
I feel truly grateful to share my journey with all of you. Everyone has talent, but talent alone is not enough. Vibrant Science Academy shaped me like a potter shapes clay with careful guidance and constant support. Without the right direction, even the most talented person can lose their way. I feel very lucky that whenever I felt lost or demotivated, their inspirational stories recharged my energy.

Vibrant Science Academy not only guided me but also conducted test series to identify our weaknesses and the areas where we needed improvement. They taught us effective revision techniques and time management skills. Their carefully designed timetable ensured that we were well-prepared for every aspect and difficulty we could face in the exams.

Before every test, they conducted revision lectures where they provided question banks and highlighted important questions. With over 15 to 16 years of teaching experience, the teachers know exactly what type of questions can appear in exams. When the final exams approached, I focused on the question banks they supplied, and many of the questions appeared in my exam.

After every test series, they also held doubt-solving sessions, which helped me analyze my mistakes and perform better in the next test. In short, the teachers at Vibrant Science Academy are extremely supportive, guiding us every step of the way.

Due to all these reasons and their constant guidance, I am proud to share that I have secured the 1st rank in St Anne’s junior college

The various MCQ modules and their detailed notes helped me stay consistent throughout. They also gave special attention to doubt-solving and made sure revisions were done properly well before the exams. The learning environment was highly encouraging and nurturing, for both academic excellence and personal growth. The lessons I learned there not just from books, but from the people and experiences will always stay with me. The balance of hard work and fun I had at Vibrant made those two years unforgettable and truly shaped me.
